stories.headline: Mass rallies support President Pavel amid constitutional crisis with government
stories.summary: Tens of thousands of Czechs rallied in Prague and other cities to support President Petr Pavel in his dispute with the government over ministerial appointments. The protests were organized in response to Pavel's refusal to appoint Filip Turek as environment minister and subsequent tensions with Foreign Minister Macinka.

stories.headline: President Pavel accuses Foreign Minister Macinka of extortion over blocked ministerial appointment
stories.summary: President Petr Pavel accused Foreign Minister Petr Macinka of potential extortion after blocking the appointment of Filip Turek as environment minister. Pavel said Macinka sent unacceptable text messages to his adviser threatening political consequences.

articles.title: Czech rift deepens as president accuses foreign minister of 'blackmail'

stories.headline: Okamura sparks controversy over Ukrainian flag display on Charles Bridge
stories.summary: Parliament Speaker Tomio Okamura criticized the display of a large Ukrainian flag on Prague's Charles Bridge during Unity Day celebrations, calling it an unnecessary provocation. The incident drew condemnation from churches and sparked debates about Czech-Ukrainian relations.

stories.headline: Government freezes defense spending at 2% GDP, defying NATO pressure for increases
stories.summary: The Czech government approved its 2026 budget maintaining defense spending at 2% of GDP, with Speaker Okamura stating this level is sufficient. The decision goes against NATO calls for higher spending and focuses budget increases on transport and family programs instead.

stories.headline: Opposition schedules no-confidence vote against Babiš government for next week
stories.summary: Parliament Speaker Okamura scheduled a no-confidence vote against the ANO-SPD-Motorists coalition government for next Tuesday. Opposition parties submitted the required signatures, though Okamura expressed confidence the government would survive the vote.

stories.headline: Czech government reconsiders China engagement amid Trump-Xi dynamics
stories.summary: Prague is considering renewed engagement with Beijing while carefully calibrating its approach to US President Trump's China policy. Czech officials indicate the government is operating on the assumption of a three-pole global order between the US, China, and Russia.

articles.title: Czech Government Looks For Its Footing On Europe's New US-China Tightrope
